source.note: Institution-level Key Stage 2 attainment from the DfE Explore Education Statistics API. Built for parental choice comparison, not school governance. Progress measures are sparse for 2024/25 because of missing KS1 baselines. On-demand local authority pack: Portsmouth (seed maintained set remains Hampshire).  Secondary-age state and independent schools carry Key Stage 4 and 16–18 (A-level) outcomes where published (nil/zero English & maths GCSE returns cleared; EBacc subject pillars used as fallbacks when possible). Independents also carry Ofsted grades for non-association schools and GIAS inspectorate/website links for ISI schools (ISI search prefers postcode). Inspection précis fields are verbatim excerpts from the latest Ofsted or ISI report PDF, with footnote links to the source file.

independent.note: Mean of independents in this index with usable KS4 figures (nil/zero returns removed); KS5 means use A-level APS where published

stateKs4.note: Mean of state schools in this index with usable KS4 figures (nil/zero returns removed); KS5 means use A-level APS where published

phonics.note: DfE publishes phonics screening results for England and local authorities only — not for individual schools. KS1 teacher assessment is no longer collected nationally (from 2023/24).
